options.content:
**Scope & caveats:**

- **All AI figures on this dashboard are Claude Code OTel-only**, scoped to the Project and Claude Code OTel Teams filters above. Legacy Claude Admin-API and Cursor activity are excluded — neither carries a reliable per-project mapping, so mixing them in would make these comparisons incomparable to the project-scoped panels elsewhere in the AI dashboard set. The human (merged-PR) side uses the same Project filter; the team filter applies only to OTel data.
- **AI Lines vs Merged Lines** divides Claude Code OTel lines added by additions in merged PR diffs. The two are counted independently: session lines are not verified as committed, and edits made through Bash or scripts never reach OTel. Errors run both ways (see the panel description), so read it as a direction, not a precise attribution; 100% is a cap, not proof that all code was AI-written.
- **Accepted Edits by Language** is queried from Claude Code OTel hourly tool-usage telemetry rather than the shared domain layer, because the shared AI-tool-decisions table does not carry a language dimension.

panels.description: Claude Code OTel lines added in the selected range, as a percentage of lines added by PRs merged in the same range, capped at 100%. The two sides are counted independently and never matched line by line, so this is a ratio of AI-produced lines to shipped lines, not verified attribution. It reads low when code was changed through Bash or scripts rather than Claude's Edit/Write tools (OTel does not count those), when the range predates OTel collection or covers teams not connected to OTel, and when merged PRs include work by people not using Claude Code, lockfiles or generated files. It reads high when Claude rewrote the same lines several times, or wrote code that ended up in rejected PRs, abandoned branches or throwaway scripts. 100% means OTel counted at least as many lines as were merged, not that all merged code was AI-written. Merged PRs use the Project filter; OTel lines use Project and OTel Teams.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT LEAST(100, ROUND(100.0 * ai.ai_lines / NULLIF(human.human_lines, 0), 1)) AS "AI Lines vs Merged Lines %"
FROM
  (SELECT SUM(lines_added) AS ai_lines FROM ai_activities
   WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
     AND source_connection_id IN (
       SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
       INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
       WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
     )
     AND $__timeFilter(date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR CONCAT('em:', user_email) IN ($developer) OR user_email IN (SELECT g_d.author_email FROM _tool_github_commits g_d WHERE g_d.author_id > 0 AND CONCAT('gh:', g_d.author_id) IN ($developer)))) ai,
  (SELECT SUM(pr.additions) AS human_lines FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
   WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))) human

panels.title: AI Lines vs Merged Lines

panels.description: Distinct OTel `user_email` values with canonical Claude Code activity divided by distinct name-deduplicated authors of merged PRs. Both are filtered by Project; only OTel activity is filtered by OTel Teams. The identities are not cross-matched, so this is a directional ratio and may exceed 100%.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * ai.n / NULLIF(c.n, 0), 1) AS "Engineers Adopted %"
FROM
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_email) n FROM ai_activities
   WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
     AND source_connection_id IN (
       SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
       INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
       WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
     )
     AND $__timeFilter(date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR CONCAT('em:', user_email) IN ($developer) OR user_email IN (SELECT g_d.author_email FROM _tool_github_commits g_d WHERE g_d.author_id > 0 AND CONCAT('gh:', g_d.author_id) IN ($developer))) AND user_email != '') ai,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name,''), pr.author_name)) n FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))) c

panels.title: Engineers Adopted %

panels.description: Total lines added inside Claude Code OTel sessions, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s) (`SUM(ai_activities.lines_added)`).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(lines_added) AS "AI Lines Added"
FROM ai_activities
WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
  AND source_connection_id IN (
    SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
    WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR CONCAT('em:', user_email) IN ($developer) OR user_email IN (SELECT g_d.author_email FROM _tool_github_commits g_d WHERE g_d.author_id > 0 AND CONCAT('gh:', g_d.author_id) IN ($developer)))

panels.title: AI Lines Added

panels.description: Accepted Claude Code OTel edit-tool decisions ÷ decisions offered, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s) (`ai_tool_decisions`, which only Claude Code OTel writes to).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(accepted_count) / NULLIF(SUM(accepted_count) + SUM(rejected_count), 0), 1) AS "Edit Acceptance %"
FROM ai_tool_decisions
WHERE source_connection_id IN (
  SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
  WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
)
AND $__timeFilter(date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR CONCAT('em:', user_email) IN ($developer) OR user_email IN (SELECT g_d.author_email FROM _tool_github_commits g_d WHERE g_d.author_id > 0 AND CONCAT('gh:', g_d.author_id) IN ($developer)))

panels.title: Edit Acceptance %
Share of Lines Changed, With Adoption

panels.description: Weekly Claude Code OTel lines added as a percentage of lines added by PRs merged that week, capped at 100%; the grey bar is the rest of the merged lines. The two sides are counted independently and never matched line by line, so this is a ratio of AI-produced lines to shipped lines, not verified attribution, and has the same biases as AI Lines vs Merged Lines above: it reads low for edits made through Bash or scripts, weeks before OTel collection and merged work by people not using Claude Code; it reads high for rewritten lines and code that was never merged. Weekly values are also noisier, because lines written one week are often merged the next. Weeks with no merged PRs show no bar. The dashed adopted-engineer series is on a separate scale and is an unverified ratio of OTel users to merged-PR authors. Merged PRs use the Project filter; OTel data uses Project and OTel Teams. Weeks begin Monday.

targets.rawSql:
WITH weeks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week
  FROM ai_activities
  WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
    AND source_connection_id IN (
      SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
      INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
      WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
    )
    AND $__timeFilter(date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR CONCAT('em:', user_email) IN ($developer) OR user_email IN (SELECT g_d.author_email FROM _tool_github_commits g_d WHERE g_d.author_id > 0 AND CONCAT('gh:', g_d.author_id) IN ($developer)))
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.merged_date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')
  FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
  WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))
),
ai_w AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') week, SUM(lines_added) v
  FROM ai_activities
  WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
    AND source_connection_id IN (
      SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
      INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
      WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
    )
    AND $__timeFilter(date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR CONCAT('em:', user_email) IN ($developer) OR user_email IN (SELECT g_d.author_email FROM _tool_github_commits g_d WHERE g_d.author_id > 0 AND CONCAT('gh:', g_d.author_id) IN ($developer)))
  GROUP BY 1
),
hu_w AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.merged_date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') week, SUM(pr.additions) v
  FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
  WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))
  GROUP BY 1
),
ai_users_w AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') week, COUNT(DISTINCT user_email) n
  FROM ai_activities
  WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
    AND source_connection_id IN (
      SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
      INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
      WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
    )
    AND $__timeFilter(date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR CONCAT('em:', user_email) IN ($developer) OR user_email IN (SELECT g_d.author_email FROM _tool_github_commits g_d WHERE g_d.author_id > 0 AND CONCAT('gh:', g_d.author_id) IN ($developer))) AND user_email != ''
  GROUP BY 1
),
contrib_w AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.merged_date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') week, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name,''), pr.author_name)) n
  FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
  WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT STR_TO_DATE(w.week, '%Y-%m-%d') AS time, 'AI lines' AS metric,
  LEAST(100, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(ai_w.v, 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(hu_w.v, 0), 0), 1)) AS value
FROM weeks w LEFT JOIN ai_w ON ai_w.week = w.week LEFT JOIN hu_w ON hu_w.week = w.week
UNION ALL
SELECT STR_TO_DATE(w.week, '%Y-%m-%d'), 'Other merged lines',
  100 - LEAST(100, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(ai_w.v, 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(hu_w.v, 0), 0), 1))
FROM weeks w LEFT JOIN ai_w ON ai_w.week = w.week LEFT JOIN hu_w ON hu_w.week = w.week
UNION ALL
SELECT STR_TO_DATE(w.week, '%Y-%m-%d'), 'Engineers adopted',
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(au.n, 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(c.n, 0), 0), 1)
FROM weeks w LEFT JOIN ai_users_w au ON au.week = w.week LEFT JOIN contrib_w c ON c.week = w.week
ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: AI Lines vs Merged Lines (Weekly), With Adoption
AI-Attributed Volume by Language (Claude Code OTel only)

panels.description: Weekly accepted-edit volume by programming language, from Claude Code OTel telemetry, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s). Plugin-internal source — the shared AI-tool-decisions table doesn't carry a language dimension. Bucketed weekly rather than monthly since Claude Code OTel history is currently short.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(hour_start), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(hour_start) DAY) AS time, language AS metric, SUM(accepted_count) AS value
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_tool_usage
WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_start) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR CONCAT('em:', user_email) IN ($developer) OR user_email IN (SELECT g_d.author_email FROM _tool_github_commits g_d WHERE g_d.author_id > 0 AND CONCAT('gh:', g_d.author_id) IN ($developer)))
  AND (team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
  AND connection_id IN (
    SELECT connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects WHERE project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
  )
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY metric, time

panels.title: Accepted Edits by Language (Weekly)

panels.description: Exact accepted/rejected edit totals by language from the same Claude Code OTel source as the chart above, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s), with a per-language acceptance-rate column.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT language AS "Language", SUM(accepted_count) AS "Accepted Edits", SUM(rejected_count) AS "Rejected Edits",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(accepted_count) / NULLIF(SUM(accepted_count) + SUM(rejected_count), 0), 1) AS "Acceptance %"
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_tool_usage
WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_start) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR CONCAT('em:', user_email) IN ($developer) OR user_email IN (SELECT g_d.author_email FROM _tool_github_commits g_d WHERE g_d.author_id > 0 AND CONCAT('gh:', g_d.author_id) IN ($developer)))
  AND (team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
  AND connection_id IN (
    SELECT connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects WHERE project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
  )
GROUP BY language
ORDER BY SUM(accepted_count) DESC

panels.title: Accepted / Rejected Edits by Language (Totals)

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT p.name AS __text, p.name AS __value
FROM projects p
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp ON cp.project_name = p.name
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
INNER JOIN user_project_mapping upm ON upm.project_name = p.name
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY p.name;
list.label: Project
list.name: project
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT p.name AS __text, p.name AS __value
FROM projects p
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp ON cp.project_name = p.name
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
INNER JOIN user_project_mapping upm ON upm.project_name = p.name
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY p.name;

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT
    c.team_slug AS __text,
    c.team_slug AS __value
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections AS c
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects AS cp
    ON cp.connection_id = c.id
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND (cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY c.team_slug;
list.label: Claude Code OTel teams
list.name: otel_teams
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    c.team_slug AS __text,
    c.team_slug AS __value
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections AS c
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects AS cp
    ON cp.connection_id = c.id
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND (cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY c.team_slug;

list.definition:
WITH scoped_conn AS (
  SELECT cp.connection_id
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
  WHERE c.status = 'active'
    AND cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
),
otel AS (
  SELECT user_email AS email FROM ai_activities
  WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity' AND user_email <> '' AND source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM scoped_conn) AND $__timeFilter(date)
  UNION
  SELECT user_email FROM ai_model_usages
  WHERE user_email <> '' AND source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM scoped_conn) AND $__timeFilter(date)
),
linked AS (
  SELECT o.email, MIN(g.author_id) AS gid
  FROM otel o
  JOIN _tool_github_commits g ON g.author_email = o.email AND g.author_id > 0
  GROUP BY o.email
),
pr_authors AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1) AS UNSIGNED) AS gid, MAX(pr.author_name) AS login
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
  WHERE pm.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND pr.author_name NOT LIKE '%[bot]'
    AND ($__timeFilter(pr.created_date) OR $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) OR $__timeFilter(pr.closed_date))
  GROUP BY 1
),
people AS (
  SELECT CONCAT('gh:', l.gid) AS k, l.gid, MIN(l.email) AS email, NULL AS login, 1 AS has_ai FROM linked l GROUP BY l.gid
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CONCAT('em:', o.email), NULL, o.email, NULL, 1 FROM otel o WHERE o.email NOT IN (SELECT email FROM linked)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CONCAT('gh:', p.gid), p.gid, NULL, p.login, 0 FROM pr_authors p WHERE p.gid NOT IN (SELECT gid FROM linked)
),
named AS (
  SELECT p.k, p.has_ai, COALESCE(ga.login, p.login, p.email) AS handle,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(ga.name, ''), ga.login, p.login, p.email) AS name
  FROM people p
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(login) AS login, MAX(name) AS name FROM _tool_github_accounts GROUP BY id) ga ON ga.id = p.gid
)
SELECT CONCAT(
    name,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY name) > 1 AND handle <> name THEN CONCAT(' (', handle, ')') ELSE '' END,
    CASE WHEN k LIKE 'em:%' THEN ' · no GitHub link' WHEN has_ai = 0 THEN ' · no AI data' ELSE '' END
  ) AS __text,
  k AS __value
FROM named
ORDER BY has_ai DESC, __text;
list.description: OTel developers in the selected projects and teams, plus GitHub authors of PRs in the selected projects. AI data matches on OTel email; PRs match on the GitHub account that GitHub links to that email through commits. Task and defect panels ignore this filter.
list.label: Developer
list.name: developer
list.query:
WITH scoped_conn AS (
  SELECT cp.connection_id
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
  WHERE c.status = 'active'
    AND cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
),
otel AS (
  SELECT user_email AS email FROM ai_activities
  WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity' AND user_email <> '' AND source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM scoped_conn) AND $__timeFilter(date)
  UNION
  SELECT user_email FROM ai_model_usages
  WHERE user_email <> '' AND source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM scoped_conn) AND $__timeFilter(date)
),
linked AS (
  SELECT o.email, MIN(g.author_id) AS gid
  FROM otel o
  JOIN _tool_github_commits g ON g.author_email = o.email AND g.author_id > 0
  GROUP BY o.email
),
pr_authors AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1) AS UNSIGNED) AS gid, MAX(pr.author_name) AS login
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
  WHERE pm.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND pr.author_name NOT LIKE '%[bot]'
    AND ($__timeFilter(pr.created_date) OR $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) OR $__timeFilter(pr.closed_date))
  GROUP BY 1
),
people AS (
  SELECT CONCAT('gh:', l.gid) AS k, l.gid, MIN(l.email) AS email, NULL AS login, 1 AS has_ai FROM linked l GROUP BY l.gid
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CONCAT('em:', o.email), NULL, o.email, NULL, 1 FROM otel o WHERE o.email NOT IN (SELECT email FROM linked)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CONCAT('gh:', p.gid), p.gid, NULL, p.login, 0 FROM pr_authors p WHERE p.gid NOT IN (SELECT gid FROM linked)
),
named AS (
  SELECT p.k, p.has_ai, COALESCE(ga.login, p.login, p.email) AS handle,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(ga.name, ''), ga.login, p.login, p.email) AS name
  FROM people p
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(login) AS login, MAX(name) AS name FROM _tool_github_accounts GROUP BY id) ga ON ga.id = p.gid
)
SELECT CONCAT(
    name,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY name) > 1 AND handle <> name THEN CONCAT(' (', handle, ')') ELSE '' END,
    CASE WHEN k LIKE 'em:%' THEN ' · no GitHub link' WHEN has_ai = 0 THEN ' · no AI data' ELSE '' END
  ) AS __text,
  k AS __value
FROM named
ORDER BY has_ai DESC, __text;
